<thought>The ¹H NMR shows a para‑disubstituted aromatic ring (two doublets, 2 H each) and a cyclohexyl group attached to the ring (10 H at ~1.35 ppm from five CH₂ groups and 1 H at ~2.63 ppm from the benzylic CH). A para‑chloro substituent together with a cyclohexyl substituent fits this pattern. The SMILES for para‑chlorophenyl‑cyclohexane is **Clc1ccc(cc1)C2CCCCC2**, which validates correctly.</thought>
<final_answer>Clc1ccc(cc1)C2CCCCC2</final_answer>
